settings.title: Cashbook settings
settings.subtitle: Settings apply to this store only.
settings.autoInvoiceCashInHint: Automatically link received cash payments from invoices. Unpaid invoices and digital payments are excluded.
settings.autoExpenseCashOutHint: Automatically link expenses marked Paid with Cash as the payment method.
settings.autoSalaryCashOutHint: Control staff salary cash entries separately from other expenses.
settings.automationNote: These switches control new automatic entries. Existing linked entries continue to sync; cancellations still reverse them. Saving settings does not import old transactions.
settings.requireDescriptionHint: A description must be supplied for manual cashbook entries.
settings.allowBackdatedEntriesHint: Allow manual entries dated before the current Indian business day.
settings.openingHint: Set the actual cash in hand for this date. This recalculates that day’s balance and carries the change into later days.
settings.ownerOnly: Only the store owner can manage cashbook settings.

day.title: Daily cash balances
day.carryHint: Cash carries forward on every date, including days with no activity. Times are in India time (IST).
day.openHint: Opening cash is carried forward from your last closing. The business day stays open past midnight until you close it.

reconciliation.title: Reconcile cash
reconciliation.autoHint: Opening and closing balances are automatic. No daily opening or closing action is needed.
reconciliation.adjustmentHint: Enter actual cash in hand. Any shortage or excess is saved as an adjustment entry with your reason.
reconciliation.pendingHint: Sync pending changes to update cloud balances and reconcile cash.
